purpose: 锁定本 change 开始前已批准的 24 个 Artwork 身份/精确源版本，展示新五类角色调整的工程、美术及批准缺口。历史批准原范围不扩大。

baseline.worktreeAtStart: clean except active untracked OpenSpec change

requiredCategories.criterion: 需要两个真实轮廓/外观结果和精确 Artwork 绑定的已验收资源。
需要两个实际可达、符合材质且分区正确的配色结果。
需要两个实际可达的五官/静态表情结果。
需要无服装与至少一件真实适配服装等两个结果。
需要无配饰与至少一件真实适配配件/物品等两个结果。

additionalArtworkCandidates: subject-map.md and briefs/README.md enumerate planning candidates; they are not in the baseline or current public Artwork denominator until actual Artwork is registered. Once approved for the default Gallery, add each exact Artwork/version to the coverage matrix; pending candidates never count.
